tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Window background behind everything: content pane, chat thread, settings pages.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Sidebar, inline tints (thinking blocks, info rows, user messages) and tinted cards.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Things that sit on top: composer, sheets, menus, Review items, inputs.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings and the mascot's body. 15:1 or better on ground, surface and raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: sidebar rows, descriptions, list metadata that still has to be read. 7:1+ on every ground.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps, token counts, placeholders. 4.5:1+ on ground, surface and raised in both themes; never for anything you must act on.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers between list rows and the line under headers. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Outline of secondary buttons, cards and chips. The label carries the control, so this line is not relied on for contrast.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen to work: text fields, switch tracks when off, checkboxes. 3:1+ on ground and raised.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Thread green. Primary action (Send, Approve, Run plan), approved and done states, the focus ring, the scope pill's text accent. 5:1 on ground.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `green` fill.

tokens.name: green-wash
tokens.usage: Tint for approved knowledge, the active sidebar row, the scope pill and Done items.

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: Text on `green-wash` (6.8:1 light, 7.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Needs you: the Review count badge, the mascot's needs-you dot, Needs you items. Never decoration.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text on a `blue` fill, such as the Review badge.

tokens.name: blue-wash
tokens.usage: Tint for Needs you items, model-error cards and the client-scope chip.

tokens.name: blue-text
tokens.usage: Text on `blue-wash` (6.4:1 light, 7.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: amber-wash
tokens.usage: Tint for Conflict items and knowledge proposals waiting in a chat.

tokens.name: amber-text
tokens.usage: Text on `amber-wash` (6.6:1 light, 8.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive menu rows (Delete chat) and their confirm button. 6:1+ on ground, surface and raised in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset.

tokens.name: toast
tokens.usage: Undo toast background.

tokens.name: on-toast
tokens.usage: Toast text.

tokens.name: toast-action
tokens.usage: The Undo action inside a toast.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the window behind a sheet.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Page titles in Settings and full pages.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Pane headers: Review, a scope's name, Everywhere.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section headings inside a page or sheet.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Two quotes found: 8,400 (12 Sep) and 9,100 (30 Sep). Which is current?
styles.usage: Default interface text: Review items, lists, settings rows, buttons.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Five top-level sections: Models and keys, Sources, Memory and privacy, Voice, General.
styles.usage: Assistant answers in a chat, kept to about 70 characters a line.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: Thinking · checking whether Image studio moved to Advanced…
styles.usage: Thinking and tool blocks, sheet notes, menu rows.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Sidebar section labels and inspector headings. Sentence case, no letter-spacing.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: File paths, timers, token counts, commit hashes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a chip or between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons and between items in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside Review items and list rows; gap between Review items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inspector padding; gap between sections in a sheet.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between messages in a chat thread; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of the content pane.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Padding of full settings pages.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu rows, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, sidebar rows, toasts' inner controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Review items, cards, info rows, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Plan cards and the artifact frame.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of a sheet.

tokens.name: radius-composer
tokens.usage: The composer.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, the scope pill, switches.

tokens.name: shadow-composer
tokens.usage: The composer floating over the thread.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, the model picker, the / menu.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets rising from the bottom of the window.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: The undo toast.
